 Hands-on AI-assisted software development: Personally design, write, review, test, debug, deploy, and maintain code using modern AI-assisted development approaches. Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Owner’s acquisition engine first identifies what makes a given restaurant unique, evaluates local demand for its offerings, and assesses the most relevant competition to determine the best strategy for promoting that restaurant. Then, the platform automatically generates relevant website pages and content, monitors results over time, and evolves its strategy as it gets more data.



We are looking for a mission-driven engineer who is passionate about their craft and committed to building incredible products for our customers.

About PCR & Orbit
 Professional Computing Resources (PCR) supports complex, regulated organizations, especially higher education and the public sector, with technology asset management solutions across hardware and telecom.
 Orbit is PCR’s new cloud product for software lifecycle management. Orbit unifies software spend, usage, renewals, vendor contracts, and ROI insights into a single system of record, paired with an AI powered layer that helps teams surface what matters and what to do next.
 Orbit has a strong runway through PCR’s installed base, with a large horizontal opportunity beyond it. Orbit is the starting point, not the finish line. We intend to keep shipping modules and adjacent products over time to address more of the IT workflow in higher ed and the public sector, leveraging PCR’s distribution and Valsoft’s operational strength to move quickly.
 The role
 We’re hiring a Head of Revenue to lead Orbit’s go to market from launch through early scale. This is the first dedicated commercial hire for Orbit. You will own pipeline creation, run full cycle deals, and build the repeatable sales motion we will scale over time.
 This is a hands on operator role. You will be a key bridge between the market and product, turning customer discovery into clear requirements, prioritization, and shipped capabilities that drive adoption and profitable growth. You will also continuously look for ways to grow Orbit and expand the opportunity, both by extending Orbit into adjacent workflows and by identifying new modules or product opportunities beyond Orbit that fit the higher ed and public sector IT workflow where PCR already plays today.
 As traction grows, we will add tools and capacity such as marketing support, SDR support, and partners, but early on you will be the person driving momentum.
 What you’ll do and own
 1) Own revenue end to end, hands on
 Own new revenue for Orbit and take a hands on approach to closing business
 Build pipeline through targeted outbound, webinars and events, partnerships, and leveraging PCR’s installed base
 Run deals end to end from discovery to demo to pilot or proof to proposal to negotiation to close
 Sell to cross functional stakeholders and buying committees across IT, procurement, finance, and operations
 Maintain strong CRM hygiene, forecasting, and a consistent weekly operating cadence for pipeline reviews and deal strategy
 2) Build demand in a scrappy, repeatable way
 Create and run outbound motions including account lists, sequencing, messaging tests, and a call email LinkedIn mix
 Develop campaigns that create spikes in demand such as webinars, customer showcases, partner sessions, and conference follow ups
 Establish a simple measurable funnel and iterate quickly using conversion rates, cycle length, and win loss themes
 Use PCR’s credibility, relationships, and customer access to accelerate trust and shorten cycles
 3) Translate market feedback into shipped must haves
 Spend meaningful time in customer conversations to understand workflows, blockers, and urgency drivers
 Turn insights into structured inputs for product and engineering including requirements, prioritization, integrations, packaging, and what needs to be true to win and expand
 Partner closely with product and engineering to sharpen workflows and push fast iterations that improve conversion, adoption, and retention
 Create early proof points such as reference customers, case studies, and outcome narratives
 4) Keep expanding the opportunity, Orbit and beyond
 Continuously look for opportunities to expand Orbit into adjacent needs across the higher ed and public sector IT workflow where PCR plays today
 Identify and validate new modules, integrations, and next products through discovery, then help turn the best opportunities into a clear build and sell plan
 Bring a GM mindset to growth by increasing ACV, improving retention and expansion, and strengthening Orbit’s strategic position over the next three to five years
 5) Build the foundation for scale
 Create the repeatable sales playbook including ICP, messaging, talk tracks, demo narrative, objection handling, sequences, and lightweight enablement
 Recommend when to add capacity such as SDR, marketing support, partners, and CS based on leading indicators and what is proven
 Help define the longer term commercial approach including coverage model, partner strategy, and the operating cadence that scales
 Ideal background and requirements
 Must haves
 6 to 12 plus years in B2B SaaS revenue roles with full cycle closing experience
 Proven ability to create pipeline, not just work inbound, and deliver against a revenue target
 Experience selling into multi stakeholder, multi budget environments with comfort navigating procurement, legal, and security
 Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills
 High ownership and operational discipline, you run a tight cadence, keep deals moving, and improve the system
 Experience in a startup, early stage, or bootstrapped environment where you wore multiple hats and built GTM foundations
 Demonstrated ability to work with product, identify product opportunities from customer feedback, and translate them into must haves with product and engineering
 Experience launching a new product or building a repeatable motion from scratch
 Nice to haves
 Higher ed, public sector, or healthcare experience
 Familiarity with ITSM, ITAM, SAM, procurement, vendor management, or contract lifecycle concepts
 Partnership or channel experience with resellers, associations, consultants, or ISV partners
 AI curiosity and comfort positioning AI enabled workflows credibly with practical value, not buzzwords
 Compensation
 Base salary plus bonus tied to value creation in Orbit, specifically profitable MRR growth, with a ramp period and milestone based accelerators aligned to early stage execution.
 Location and travel
 Remote friendly, with travel for key customer meetings, conferences, and relationship building as needed.

 The Intake Worker is responsible for providing a welcoming, safe, and supportive first point of contact for youth who are experiencing homelessness, are at immediate risk of homelessness, or require housing-related assistance. Working within a trauma-informed, youth-centered, Housing First for Youth-aligned approach, the Intake Worker responds to all inquiries for services, completes initial screenings and gathering of call data, ensures accurate and timely documentation, identifies immediate safety concerns that require timely escalation, and coordinates access to emergency shelter, diversion, homelessness prevention, and community-based supports.
 HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT  🎯
 Central Intake and Initial Response 
 Serve as a central point of contact for youth seeking emergency shelter, housing assistance, transitional housing access, diversion services or other supports.

 Gather relevant information regarding the youth’s immediate circumstances, housing status, presenting needs and current level of risk.
 Maintain accurate call logs and wait lists, as required.
 Provide consistent, accurate, relevant, and timely information in all communications and data sets to support and inform decision-making.
 In consultation with the Diversion team, determine the urgency of each request and prioritize response based on safety, vulnerability and immediate housing needs.
 Screening, Assessment and Service Planning 
 Initiate the Diversion Assessment process for youth seeking shelter, and gather initial information about the caller, as required per intake and triage protocol.
 Document the youth’s immediate shelter and housing needs, including where the youth stayed previously and where they may be able to safely stay that evening.

 Consult with supervisors or appropriate clinical, crisis or emergency services when elevated risks are identified.

 Document inquiries, referrals, admissions, unsuccessful contacts, interventions, and service outcomes.

Bug Squisher Wanted: You’re an expert at making sure websites, storefronts, and backend systems work smoothly before they go live. But you don’t just catch bugs. You build the systems that catch bugs before anyone else ever sees them. You can spot flaky tests from a mile away. Your test architecture is clean, scalable, and easy for other developers to follow. And when it comes to troubleshooting, you’re relentless — in the best possible way.
 If this sounds like you, and you’re excited about a workday that’s fun, collaborative, technical, and full of purpose, let’s chat!
 AlgaeCal is on the lookout for a Lead QA Developer to bring their skills to our lively QA team and help transform lives, one stable release at a time.
 Small print here ⇒ We’re an eCommerce company. So, we want you to have eCommerce experience. Lots of it. You’ll be helping us improve the quality, stability, and reliability of our React-based storefront and internal middleware. So if automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and digital marketing technology don’t light at least a small fire in your belly, you probably shouldn’t read any further. 
 Still here? Okay then…
 This job will give you ALL the feels: 
 At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.
 The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.
 You’ll love it here: 
 You’ll be working with a great team. The developers at AlgaeCal have been there, done that, and got the t-shirt. They’ve written more code than Alan Turing. They’ve learned more programming languages than C3PO. They’ve immersed themselves in so many development tasks that they’ve had to be pulled out of the Matrix by their ankles on a Friday evening. And the best part? They’re friendly, funny, and easy to work with.
 You’ll use your powers for good. This isn’t one of those jobs that crush your soul with mindless tasks. On the contrary! You’ll help build the quality engineering systems that let us ship better storefront experiences, stronger middleware, and more reliable eCommerce platforms — all so we can spread a powerful message: bone loss is beatable.
 You won’t be micromanaged. We’ll give you a clear set of KPIs, meaningful ownership, and crystal clear expectations. You’ll know what success looks like: stronger automation frameworks, cleaner CI/CD integration, fewer flaky tests, better reporting, and fewer defects slipping through to production.
 We don’t have mattresses at the office. Seriously Elon, what’s up with that?!? You’ll be relieved to know this isn’t one of those Silicon Valley gigs that expects you to work ridiculously long hours and frowns upon family time. We’re not like that! We enjoy our life, and we want you to enjoy yours too.
 This job might be for you if you’ve got… 
 5+ years of QA development experience, with real examples of automated testing strategies you’ve built, maintained, improved, or scaled.
 2+ years of leadership, mentorship, or coaching experience. You don’t need a giant ego or a fancy title. But you do need to know how to guide other QA developers, review their work, support their growth, and raise the technical standard of the team.
 A strong command of JavaScript and TypeScript. You don’t need to speak in code at dinner parties, (in fact, please don’t), but you should be very comfortable writing, reviewing, and improving automated tests in a modern JS/TS environment.
 Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks like Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools. If you’ve ever made a flaky test suite faster, cleaner, and more reliable, we’d love to hear about it.
 The know-how to architect, optimize, and scale automated testing frameworks across frontend storefronts and backend middleware. Around here, that means working across our Shopify Hydrogen storefront and middleware
 Experience integrating automated tests into cloud-based CI/CD pipelines. You understand that automation is only useful if it gives developers fast, reliable feedback, and doesn’t randomly blow up the build because someone sneezed near the test runner.
 A sharp eye for quality metrics. We’re talking automation coverage, pipeline stability, test execution runtimes, flaky test reduction, production defect leakage, and the kind of reporting that helps the whole team make better decisions.
 Comfort with specialized QA spaces like API contract testing, performance profiling, load testing, and browser developer tool profiling. You don’t have to know everything. But you do need to be curious, technical, and willing to dig. We’d also be impressed if you’ve worked with Python, PHP, Figma, Storybook, or Jest.
 Next level bug prevention skills. In fact, you’re so good at dealing with bugs you should probably be deployed on a mission to Klendathu.
 Now, time to be honest: is this really you? 
If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you.
 Other Qualities You’ll Need 
 At AlgaeCal, we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities: 
 You’re humble — you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
 You’re hungry to learn more
 You’re people smart — in the sense that you’re a great teammate
 The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities, you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.
 What Will You Earn? 
 We believe in rewarding top talent. Let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that.
 You’ll also enjoy the following benefits: 
 A generous healthcare package
 Monthly team events and activities
 Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
 Casual dress code
 And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.
 How To Apply 
 So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?
 Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Lead QA Developer is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:
 If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully: 
 Write a cover letter addressing: 
 Why are you the best Lead QA Developer for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements, especially around automation frameworks, CI/CD testing, defect reduction, flaky test reduction, QA metrics, or mentoring other QA developers.
 1. Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view 
 2. What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it? 
 3. What are the last three books you’ve read? 
 4. What do you do for fun? 
 5. Explain what you’re doing now for a job: 
 6. If you don’t have one, explain why. 
 7. If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere. 
 Upload your cover letter and resume 
 Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.
 Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best — and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.
 Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume. 
 Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read! 
 We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly, and you can also expect a prompt response.

Our team at Blackline Safety is growing! As a people-driven technology company, with a mission to make sure every worker returns home safely, we drive innovation, practice resiliency, demonstrate leadership, go the extra mile for our customers, and empower our people to be their best.
 The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer will provide technical leadership across these environments while working alongside dedicated cybersecurity specialists, including Cybersecurity Operations, Application Security, and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) resources.
 Reporting to the Vice President, Business Information Technology & Cybersecurity, this position will serve as the senior technical cybersecurity resource within the team and will work across Blackline Safety's global technology environment.
 The successful candidate will be highly technical, comfortable operating across multiple security domains, capable of influencing teams outside of their reporting structure, and interested in developing into broader cybersecurity leadership.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Senior Cybersecurity Engineering
 Design and implement controls, architecture patterns, technical standards, and configuration baselines across complex enterprise environments.
 Lead complex investigations, security initiatives, proof-of-concepts, and technical implementations.
 Identify systemic weaknesses, recommend practical solutions, and evaluate security technologies.
 Troubleshoot issues spanning multiple systems and serve as an escalation point for cybersecurity and technology teams.
 Translate cybersecurity strategy into executable initiatives and transition new capabilities into operations.
 Automate security enrichment, investigation, remediation, reporting, validation, and guardrails.
 Develop scripts and integrations using PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph, AWS and GitHub APIs, REST APIs, and other appropriate tools.
 Integrate preventative controls into technology deployment processes.
 Cloud Security
 Review cloud architecture, IAM, privileged access, network exposure, encryption, secrets, certificates, and key management.
 Assess logging, monitoring, CSPM/CNAPP, infrastructure-as-code, and automated deployment controls.
 Identify misconfigurations and insecure patterns, support investigations, and work with Cloud Engineering and Software teams to implement preventative controls.
 Identity & Access Security
 Conditional Access, identity protection, phishing-resistant authentication, and federation/SSO.
 Privileged access, just-in-time administration, PIM, role-based access, and least privilege.
 Service accounts, non-human identities, Active Directory hardening, and identity attack-path reduction.
 Infrastructure & Network Security
 Firewall architecture, segmentation, NAC, SASE/ZTNA, secure remote access, and administrative controls.
 Infrastructure monitoring and security configuration standards.
 Vulnerability & Exposure Management
 Validate and prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability, exposure, asset criticality, threat intelligence, and compensating controls.
 Identify attack paths and recurring weaknesses, develop remediation strategies with technical owners, and validate corrective action.
 Analyze penetration-test findings and improve visibility of the enterprise attack surface.
 Help the organization understand and reduce meaningful technical exposure.
 Cybersecurity Operations & Incident Response
 Lead or support complex investigations, technical escalation, threat hunting, containment, remediation, and root-cause analysis.
 Improve detection engineering, incident-response playbooks, tabletop exercises, and post-incident controls.

 Hiring Timeline (Hiring month): Immediate

 About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ) 
 Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.
 We work at the intersection of strategy, supply chain, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.
 Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.
 If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life.
 Role Overview 
 Workbench is FIQ's warehouse-design platform: it lets a solutions engineer draw a warehouse the way an architect draws a building. You will design, build and own Workbench’s warehouse simulation engine, wherein a warehouse design is simulated and evaluated against multiple operational scenarios. Reporting directly to the Chief Scientist, you will create simulation models that capture warehouse operations dynamics, design and build the engine that executes them, and lead its integration into our main product.
 This is a unique opportunity to build something from scratch, assemble a team, and have a direct influence on product features and technical roadmap. You will work closely with our Chief Scientist, domain experts, and developers to build a capability that does not exit. It is a genuine zero-to-one build, and you will own the simulation vertical as it grows.
 What You'll Do
 Translate warehouse operational processes into mathematical simulation models at various levels of granularity
 Identify the right simulation paradigm (or combination thereof) for the problem at hand and the best tools to solve it. 
 Benchmark the performance of the simulation engine across various types of warehouse operations
 Drive the discussion around simulation as a product by prioritizing features, establishing a technical and product roadmap, and overseeing development and integration efforts.
 Assemble and lead the team that will help build and maintain the simulation engine 
 Lean on AI tools for execution and spend your judgment on the ambiguous parts. 
 The Honest Version of the Hard Parts 
 This is genuinely zero-to-one. There is no reference tool to copy and no clean spec to build from, so the hardest part is the ambiguity. You will often start without a clear definition of what to build and will have to think your way through it. 
 Your models will shape how real warehouses get designed. All models have limitations, so it is important to be honest about what they capture and what they don’t.
 You are the lead. You carry the open questions and the vertical, not just the modeling, and you will switch context fast as the product takes shape.
 Where This Goes 
 Think chessboard, not ladder.  You will own and grow the simulation vertical, and there is real room to move into deeper research alongside the Chief Scientist and into a broader product and platform role. Tell us what you want to build and we will help you get there.

ABOUT VALPAY 
 Founded in 2022, ValPay is an all-in-one payment solution tailored to empower its partners' software platforms. Designed for ambitious business owners wanting to focus on growing their business rather than the logistics needed to run it, ValPay helps companies prevent fraud, gain access to real-time reporting, and accept both online and in-person payments. ValPay's PayFac-as-a-Service model gives its partners all the benefits of integrated payments while handling the heavy lifting.
 ValPay is a subsidiary of Valsoft.
 THE ROLE 
 As Head of Engineering, you will own the engineering organization at ValPay — how it is structured, how it delivers, and how good it gets. You will report to the CEO and work alongside product and go-to-market leadership to turn a talented, lean team into a predictable, high-performing engineering function.
 This is a build role, not a caretaker role. ValPay's engineering team has grown quickly and now needs someone to put real operating discipline behind it: a delivery rhythm people can count on, a management layer that holds, and technical standards that let the platform scale with the business — without losing the speed and hands-on energy that got ValPay here.
 We are hiring for trajectory. This role is scoped as Head of Engineering today, and it is designed as the potential path to Chief Technology Officer at ValPay. We would rather hire someone with the ceiling to grow into that seat and back them properly than hire the title and hope. What earns the step up is straightforward: a delivery organization that runs without heroics, a leadership bench you built, and a track record of technical judgment the CEO and the board can lean on.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 Own engineering delivery end to end — planning, execution, release cadence, and quality — and make it predictable enough that the business can plan around it.
 Build and lead the engineering management layer: hire, develop, and coach engineering managers, tech leads, and senior/staff engineers, and put a durable structure beneath you.
 Partner with Product on roadmap feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Product sets the what; you own the how and the when.
 Set and enforce technical standards across the platform — architecture, code quality, testing, observability, and documentation — so the system scales as GMV and merchant count grow.
 Serve as the senior technical escalation point for integrations with core payments partners (Adyen, Fiserv), working complex issues to resolution and feeding what you learn back into the platform.
 Drive AI adoption inside engineering — in the SDLC, in developer productivity, and in the product where it measurably improves outcomes.
 Own engineering operations and reliability: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and the SLAs a PCI DSS Level 1 payments platform has to hold.
 Partner with security and compliance to keep PCI DSS certification and multi-jurisdiction obligations met as the platform expands.
 Be a steady presence under pressure, and build the organizational muscle for the team to handle incidents increasingly without you.
 WHAT YOU BRING 
 8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams, with at least some of that time managing managers or tech leads.
 Proven experience building, structuring, and scaling technology organizations, ideally in high-growth environments.
 Experience hiring and developing engineering leaders, and the appetite to keep doing it.
 You can still apply hands-on technical depth, you review architecture, you can go deep in a design review or an incident, and engineers respect your judgment. You are not expected to write production code day to day.
 Strong judgment on build-versus-buy, technical debt, and where to spend engineering capacity — and the ability to explain those calls in business terms to a non-technical executive team.
 A track record of installing delivery process in a fast-moving team without killing its speed: planning cadence, release discipline, on-call, and the metrics to know whether it is working.
 Demonstrable ambition and ceiling. You want the CTO seat eventually and you can show what you have been doing to get ready for it.
 NICE TO HAVE 
 Payments, fintech, or other regulated/high-availability environments (PCI DSS, SOC 2, or similar).
 Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed environment, or integrating engineering teams from acquisitions.
 Experience with multi-tenant platform or API-first product architecture.
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 In the first six to twelve months:
 A management layer is in place: engineering managers or tech leads owning their areas, with clear scope and accountability.
 Engineering runs on a delivery rhythm the business can plan against — commitments are made and met, and slippage is visible early rather than at the deadline.
 Delivery and reliability are measured, not felt — baseline metrics exist for throughput, lead time, change failure rate, and incident response, and they are trending the right way.
 AI is in real use inside engineering, with live use cases rather than pilots.
 On-call and incident response are defined and drilled, and incidents are increasingly resolved without you in the room.
 Technical standards and architecture direction are written down, agreed, and actually followed.
 WHY VALPAY 
 Founded in 2022, ValPay is already operating at scale: a PCI DSS Level 1 certified platform running across 40+ jurisdictions in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, serving vertical software platforms in dental, marine, property management, automotive, and more.
 Growth runs on three engines, and all three run on the same platform:
 Internal sales — converting existing Valsoft GMV to ValPay, a $15B+ opportunity across the current customer base plus every new Valsoft acquisition.
 External ISV channel — signing ISVs outside the Valsoft portfolio, $25M–$50M in revenue, with $2B+ in deals already closed and now being converted into live, processing merchants.
 M&A engine — acquiring payment gateway businesses, two closed so far, with the same conversion playbook applied to each newly acquired asset.
 Embedded payments inside a portfolio of 150+ vertical software companies is distribution most payments companies spend years trying to build. ValPay already has it. What decides how fast these engines scale is the engineering organization behind them — which is the mandate of this role.
 ValPay is backed by Valsoft, which buys and holds companies indefinitely rather than selling them. You build on a long horizon, not toward an exit.

 À PROPOS DE VALPAY

Pensée pour les entrepreneurs ambitieux qui souhaitent se consacrer à la croissance de leur entreprise plutôt qu'à la logistique nécessaire à son exploitation, ValPay aide les entreprises à prévenir la fraude, à accéder à des rapports en temps réel et à accepter les paiements en ligne comme en personne. Le modèle de facilitation des paiements en tant que service (PayFac-as-a-Service) de ValPay procure à ses partenaires tous les avantages des paiements intégrés, tout en prenant en charge le gros du travail.

 LE POSTE

Vous relèverez du chef de la direction et travaillerez aux côtés des responsables du produit et de la mise en marché afin de transformer une équipe talentueuse et restreinte en une fonction d'ingénierie prévisible et très performante.
 Il s'agit d'un rôle de bâtisseur, et non de gestionnaire de statu quo. L'équipe d'ingénierie de ValPay a connu une croissance rapide et a maintenant besoin d'une personne capable d'y instaurer une véritable discipline opérationnelle : une cadence de livraison fiable, une couche de gestion solide et des normes techniques permettant à la plateforme d'évoluer au rythme de l'entreprise — sans perdre la rapidité et l'énergie concrète qui ont mené ValPay jusqu'ici.
 Nous recrutons pour le potentiel. Ce poste est défini aujourd'hui comme celui de chef de l'ingénierie, et il est conçu comme la voie d'accès possible au poste de chef de la technologie (CTO) chez ValPay. Nous préférons embaucher une personne ayant la capacité de croître vers ce rôle et l'appuyer pleinement, plutôt que d'embaucher un titre en espérant que cela fonctionne. Les conditions de cette progression sont claires : une organisation de livraison qui fonctionne sans héroïsme, un banc de leaders que vous aurez bâti, et un jugement technique sur lequel la direction et le conseil peuvent s'appuyer.

 Bâtir et diriger la couche de gestion en ingénierie : embaucher, développer et encadrer des gestionnaires de l'ingénierie, des chefs techniques et des ingénieurs seniors ou principaux, et mettre en place une structure durable sous votre responsabilité.

 Piloter l'adoption de l'IA au sein de l'ingénierie — dans le cycle de développement, dans la productivité des développeurs et dans le produit lorsque les bénéfices sont mesurables.
 Assumer les opérations d'ingénierie et la fiabilité : garde, réponse aux incidents, post-mortems et niveaux de service qu'exige une plateforme de paiement certifiée PCI DSS de niveau 1.
 Collaborer avec les équipes de sécurité et de conformité afin de maintenir la certification PCI DSS et les obligations multijuridictionnelles à mesure que la plateforme s'étend.
 Demeurer une présence stable sous pression et développer la capacité organisationnelle permettant à l'équipe de gérer les incidents de plus en plus sans vous.
 CE QUE VOUS APPORTEZ

 ATOUTS RECHERCHÉS
